headline: Names a post office in Grove City, Ohio, after Specialist Joseph W. Riley.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 2082 Stringtown Road in Grove City, Ohio, as the "Specialist Joseph W. Riley Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation. It does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or who works there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 9, 2016.
